SYMPTOM: Memory server (localhost:8765) not running. LaunchAgent showing exit code 1, crash-looping. Session had no memory injection.

CAUSE 1 (initial): sharp-libvips-darwin-arm64 missing from bun cache — fixed with npm rebuild.
CAUSE 2 (actual): ~/.cache/huggingface/hub/.../model.onnx was corrupted — invalid/truncated file.

FIX: rm -rf ~/.cache/huggingface (or target specific model directory). Server re-downloads the ONNX embedding model on next start.

PREVENT: If memory server crashes with ONNX-related errors, nuke the HF cache first before debugging anything else.

ADDITIONAL ISSUE: ralph-loop plugin hook (/Users/ned/.claude/plugins/.../ralph-loop/hooks/stop-hook.sh) loses execute permissions on every startup — plugin re-downloads files without +x bit. Non-blocking error, just noise. Can't fix permanently without forking the plugin.
